name: Yoyogi
tagline: Shinjuku in 2 minutes and Shibuya in 7 minutes. Served by 3 lines. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥130,000 to ¥140,000.
summary: The station is in Shibuya City, where JR East and the Tokyo Metropolitan Bureau of Transportation run 3 lines between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 23 minutes to Otemachi, 2 minutes to Shinjuku, 7 minutes to Shibuya and 31 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥130,000 to ¥140,000. The station stands 35 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 4.7 m. The land around the station is close to level.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 35 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 32 m to 36.7 m, a difference of 4.7 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls outside the projected inundation area. Of the nine points within 400 m of the station, 2 fall inside the area, and the deepest projection among them is less than 0.5 m. The projected depth differs block by block within the same station area, so check the ward hazard map for the specific address. Inland flooding from overwhelmed drains has no nationwide map; each ward publishes its own, and that is worth reading as well.

groceries.name: まいばすけっと 代々木1丁目店

medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 4 clinics and 8 pharmacies. The nearest hospital is 東海大学医学部付属東京病院, about 6 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is JR東京総合病院, about 6 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 3 lines serve the station. JR Yamanote Line run through it. JR Chuo-Sobu Line (Local) also call here. Toei Oedo Line are available too. The lines are split between operators (JR East runs 2 lines and the Tokyo Metropolitan Bureau of Transportation runs 1 line), so when one line stops you can change to a line run by a different company.
congestion: JR Chuo-Sobu Line (Local) runs at 151% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 錦糸町→両国, which this station is not on. Toei Oedo Line runs at 147%. Its busiest stretch is 中井→東中野, which this station is likewise not on. JR Yamanote Line runs at 136%. Its busiest stretch is 新大久保→新宿, which this station is likewise not on. At 150%, the ministry's scale describes shoulders not quite touching, with crowding near the doors. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: One room ¥130,000 to ¥140,000, 1K ¥140,000 to ¥150,000, 1LDK ¥230,000 to ¥240,000 and 2LDK ¥350,000 to ¥360,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥130,000 to ¥140,000. For 1LDK, 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.lead: Minami-Shinjuku is ahead on quiet, but Yoyogi is ahead on the number of lines and how close the centre is.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to. It takes 3 minutes longer to reach Otemachi than Yoyogi. One-room rents run about ¥8,000 lower.

neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to. It reaches Otemachi in about the same time as Yoyogi. One-room rents run about ¥18,000 higher.

noiseSources: The 首都高速4号新宿線 viaduct runs a short walk from the station. It is an expressway, so traffic is audible day and night
四谷角筈線 (1 lanes each way) runs right beside the station, so for a flat close to the station, check whether it faces the road

leads.terrain: The ground around the station is almost level, so you can choose where to live without thinking about slopes.
leads.groceries: There are 6 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 3 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: Among the 23 wards' stations, very few of the points around this one fall inside the projected inundation area for the largest rainfall the government models.
leads.stationNote: 3 lines serve the station, and the choice of connections is wider than at most stations in the 23 wards.
leads.rentRange: The balance between commuting time and rent is about average for the 23 wards.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is on the high side for the 23 wards.
leads.congestion: Morning loading on the lines here is about average for the 23 wards' stations.
leads.noiseSources: The big roads are far enough that traffic noise is unlikely to bother you.
